'''ArMek''' was a corporation that manufactured shipboard [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion]] and [[Laser/Legends|laser]] weaponry. They produced a series of [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] with SW-# designations, such as the [[SW-2 ion cannon]] and [[SW-6 ion cannon]]. Light ion cannon versions of the series were given the designation SW-#a, such as the [[SW-6a light ion cannon]].
